purpose: Fit BL conditional-linear and BG additive linear-spline exposure models under the future daily-moment loss

models.BL: Linear in standardized company characteristics, missing indicators, public states, and eight frozen economic interactions
models.BG: BL nested inside an additive piecewise-linear GAM with knots at -1, 0, and 1 training-standard deviations

objective: Month-balanced future target-month demeaned daily return-factor quadratic loss; no single-month stock beta is treated as truth
primary_comparison_sample: Rows that are future-validation eligible and B0 eligible
confirmation_data_policy: No feature month after 2019-11 and no target month after 2019-12 may enter fitting, selection, or evaluation
